verdict.rationale: Drata publishes a structured, OpenAPI-based v2 API reference at developers.drata.com/openapi/reference/v2, with per-tag endpoint pages for Personnel, Devices, Controls, Risks, Policies, Audits, Custom Connections and Monitoring Tests, plus OAuth setup docs. Nothing in the evidence shows the reference is interactive or offers runnable examples. Probes also found no raw OpenAPI spec at the standard paths. Missing for 10: evidence of a try-it/runnable request console, sample request/response code snippets, a downloadable OpenAPI spec, and independent hands-on corroboration.
